name: I.P.W. Auto Parts
old_description: What eventually started by Peter Tetzlaff out of the back of his van, now has evolved into it's very own location that has stayed in the family for the last 40 years.
about:
I.P.W. Auto Parts operates from a single location at 12040 W Feerick St in Wauwatosa, Wisconsin. The business traces its roots to Peter Tetzlaff, who began selling parts out of the back of his van; the operation has remained family-owned for roughly 40 years. Today the company is run by Sean and Mark Tetzlaff, with Kevin Stachowiak handling sales.

The store functions as a retail and wholesale outlet for automotive parts and supplies. Its inventory spans replacement parts, shop supplies, tires, oils and chemicals, and tools. Brand lines carried include Firestone, IronHead, Mastercraft, and Thunderer tires, along with a range of lubricants, cleaners, fillers, and primers. Customers can browse and purchase through an online catalog that supports vehicle-specific searches, as well as at the physical counter.

The customer base encompasses both do-it-yourself mechanics and professional repair facilities throughout the Greater Milwaukee area. The company emphasizes wholesale pricing for trade customers while maintaining a neighborhood-shop atmosphere for walk-in buyers.

The founders' original vision centered on family values and accessible pricing. The current leadership continues that ethos with the stated motto, "Our family comes first, and you're family," positioning the business as a genuine local alternative to larger chain retailers.
